dish: The smoked, split and grilled red brat (pork + beef), with curds and a Spotted Cow
w: The State Street campus bar since 1953 and Madison's brat temple — its red brat is the game-day ritual before Badger football. ESPN put it among college football's iconic stops; the Daily Cardinal and UW's alumni magazine call it part of the street's fabric.

dish: Two-liter glass beer boots of German tap beer, soft pretzels with mustard; weekend oompah
w: A Bavarian 'trinken halle' on East Wilson with 16 German taps, the passed-around glass boot, lederhosen-clad servers and live polka every Friday and Saturday — Madison's German-immigrant roots, played loud.

dish: Scratch pizza on dough and sauce made daily
w: A family-run Verona pizzeria (now several locations) that won Best Pizza in Best of Madison 2025; Isthmus reviewed its growth.
